text: わしは　あの　ニュースが　みたくて　カラーテレビを　かったんじゃ！
note: In Japan colour TVs were still a new, expensive purchase in the 1960s, and big broadcast events such as the 1964 Tokyo Olympics and the Apollo 11 landing are remembered as reasons families bought one.
claim: Colour television sets spread through Japanese households in the late 1960s and early 1970s.

check.quote: 1973年にはカラーテレビの普及率が白黒テレビを上回った
